app.elegir_tecnica: Choose a technique in the left sidebar.

fit_positive.descripcion: Fits every spectrum in a folder (sweep from 0 to +H) with 1 or 2 Lorentzian lines. Gives Hr, linewidth (peak-to-peak) and phase of each line.

fit_bipolar.descripcion: Fits every spectrum in a folder (sweep from −H to +H) with one line per branch. Gives Hr of each branch, mean Hr, field offset and widths (peak-to-peak).

broadband.descripcion: Kittel fit f(Hr) → g and M_eff (optionally H_u), and linewidth ΔH(f) → damping α and ΔH₀. Reads an output_*.txt file from the fits.

angular_ip.descripcion: Theoretical Hr vs in-plane field angle (uniaxial + cubic anisotropy), compared with a measured angular series. Parameters are not fitted: they are chosen by hand.

angular_op.descripcion: Theoretical Hr with the field rotating out of plane (0° = in plane, 90° = normal), compared with a measured angular series. Layer without in-plane anisotropy.

angular_bicapa.descripcion: Hr of the acoustic and optical modes of a coupled bilayer vs in-plane field angle, compared with a measured angular series.

dispersion.descripcion: Dispersion relation f(H) at a fixed field angle. No measured data needed.

autovectores.descripcion: Precession of M at resonance: dynamic components vs time, precession ellipses and an animated GIF. No measured data needed.

entrada.sin_entrada: This technique needs no input data.

n_lineas.ayuda: Number of Lorentzian lines fitted in each spectrum: 1 or 2. Line 1 is always the one at the highest field.

ventana.ayuda: Half-width of the field region that belongs to one line. Used to estimate the initial values of each line and to hide the first one while looking for the second.
ventana.aviso: It should be larger than a linewidth and smaller than the separation between the two lines.

extensiones.ayuda: Extensions of the spectrum files that are read, separated by commas (for example: .dat, .txt). Files starting with fit_ or output_ are always skipped.

skiprows.ayuda: Number of header lines skipped when reading each spectrum.

col_Hr.ayuda: Column number of the resonance field in the file. Column 0 is the frequency or angle.

col_ancho.ayuda: Column number of the peak-to-peak linewidth.

g_limites.ayuda: Allowed range of g in the Kittel fit, as two numbers separated by a comma: 2.0, 2.2.
g_limites.aviso: If g ends at one of the limits, the fit is forced and its error is not reliable.

ajustar_Hu.ayuda: Yes: fit the uniaxial anisotropy field. No: keep it fixed at the H_u value.

H_uniaxial.ayuda: Uniaxial anisotropy field (fixed value, or ignored if it is fitted).

H_cubico.ayuda: Cubic anisotropy field. Always fixed: along an easy axis it cannot be separated from H_u.

eje_facil.ayuda: Yes: the field is along an easy axis. No: along a hard axis. Selects the Kittel formula.
eje_facil.aviso: The hard-axis formula is pending revision in the code.

col_angulo.ayuda: Column number of the angle in the file (usually 0).

defasaje_deg.ayuda: Shift of the experimental angles so that they match the theory. Measured points are plotted at (angle − offset).

Hu.ayuda: In-plane uniaxial anisotropy field. The easy axis is at ang_u.

Hc.ayuda: Cubic (four-fold) anisotropy field. With H_c > 0 the easy axes are at 45° from the reference.

ang_u.ayuda: In-plane direction of the uniaxial easy axis, measured from the same reference as the field angle (for example MgO[100]).

frecuencia.ayuda: Measurement frequency. Entered in GHz and converted to Hz before calling the function.

paso_ang.ayuda: Step between simulated angles. Smaller = more points and longer calculation.

margen_campo.ayuda: Oe added below and above the experimental Hr range for the simulation.
margen_campo.aviso: If the resonance of some angle falls outside that range, the calculation stops: increase the margin.

paso_campo.ayuda: Step of the field grid. Hr is linearly interpolated between two grid fields: smaller = more accurate Hr and slower.

paso_phi_M.ayuda: Step in degrees of the grid used to find the equilibrium angle of M (refined afterwards for bilayers and eigenvectors).

espesor_a.ayuda: Thickness of layer a. Entered in nm and converted to cm before calling the function.

espesor_b.ayuda: Thickness of layer b. Entered in nm and converted to cm before calling the function.

A.ayuda: Interlayer coupling. A > 0: ferromagnetic; A < 0: antiferromagnetic.
A.aviso: With A < 0 the names 'acoustic' (lower frequency) and 'optical' are inverted.

Hc_a.ayuda: Cubic anisotropy field of layer a.

Hc_b.ayuda: Cubic anisotropy field of layer b.

Hu_a.ayuda: Uniaxial anisotropy field of layer a.

Hu_b.ayuda: Uniaxial anisotropy field of layer b.

ang_campo.ayuda: In-plane field angle, from the same reference as the easy axis.

campo_max.ayuda: Last field of the grid (not included).

h_rf.ayuda: Amplitude of the microwave field that drives the precession. The response is linear in h_rf.

guardar_gif.ayuda: Creates the animation of the precession (takes a few more seconds).

n_tiempos.ayuda: Number of time points in one precession period, including t = 0 and t = T.

col_Hr.ayuda: Column number of Hr. For output_1peak.txt / output_2peak.txt it is 1 (line 1); for output_bipolar.txt use 5 (mean Hr).

col_ancho.ayuda: Column number of the peak-to-peak width. output_1peak.txt: 2. output_bipolar.txt: 2 (negative branch) or 4 (positive branch).

magn.ayuda: Effective magnetisation (the layer has no in-plane anisotropy: the perpendicular anisotropy is included in M_eff).

margen_campo.aviso: It must be larger than the field step.

col_Hr.ayuda: Column, or list of columns separated by commas, with the experimental Hr to plot. For output_2peak.txt: 1, 3 (both lines).

damp.ayuda: Gilbert damping. It is included in the matrix, but the frequency only changes by a term of order α².

advertencias.sobrescribe: Output files are named with some parameters; if a file with the same name already exists in the output folder, it is overwritten.
advertencias.eje_dificil: Hard axis: the hard-axis Kittel formula is pending revision in the code. Check the results.
advertencias.acople_negativo: A < 0 (antiferro): modes are named by frequency, so 'acoustic' and 'optical' are inverted. Look at the phase between layers.
advertencias.rango_ip: If at some angle the resonance falls outside the simulated field range, the calculation stops with an error: increase the field margin.

errores.par_invalido: It must be two numbers separated by a comma (for example: 2.0, 2.2).
errores.par_orden: The first value must be smaller than the second.
errores.debe_ser_positivo: It must be greater than zero.
errores.campo_min_max: The minimum field must be smaller than the maximum field.
errores.ang_inicio_fin: The end angle cannot be smaller than the start angle.
errores.margen_paso: The field margin must be larger than the field step.
